tool_input.description: Compute expected Calendar field values for test dates

result:
Only `FastDatePrinterAgentTest.java` was created (the `_tools/out` and `.sources` files are build artifacts from `test.sh` itself, not something I created manually).

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDatePrinterAgentTest.java` with 34 self-contained JUnit 5 test methods covering `FastDatePrinter`: pattern parsing for all letter rules (year, month, day, hour variants incl. midnight/noon boundary edge cases, week-year, timezone `Z`/`X` variants, literals/escaped quotes), invalid-pattern and null-argument error cases, getters, `equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`, all `format` overloads (Date/Calendar/long × String/Appendable/StringBuffer), the deprecated `format(Object, StringBuffer, FieldPosition)` dispatch, serialization round-trip, and a documented quirk around `format(Calendar)` when the calendar's zone differs from the printer's. All 34 tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
